## Checklist

- [ ] If a business rule changed or was added: `docs/BUSINESS_RULES.md` updated (rule + decision log)
- [ ] Database change is a **new** migration (applied migrations are never edited) and `docs/DATABASE_ARCHITECTURE.md` lists it
- [ ] Tests added or updated (`supabase/tests/local` for database rules, `tests/*.spec.ts` for screens)
- [ ] `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_TRACKER.md` and any affected docs (roles, API, environment variables) updated
- [ ] No secrets, real patient data or production credentials in the change
